responsibility: This file implements the compiler's binary-tree symbol table mapping interned nameKey identifiers to arbitrary payload pointers. It owns the concrete tree nodes and sentinel-root convention and provides creation, destruction, lookup, insertion, deletion, emptiness tests, predicate-based searches, and in-order callback traversal, making it the general name-to-object table used by scopes, keyword sets, and other compiler data structures.
same_name_distinction: Implements the symbolKey tree declared in GsymbolKey.h: it defines the concrete tree node layout keyed by nameKey_Name values and provides the storage-managing algorithms for insertion, lookup, deletion, predicate search, and in-order traversal.
